title: `import { ... } 'library'` syntax in `pkg.module` target leads to "Cannot read property '0' of undefined"
body:
<!-- Please don't delete this template or we'll close your issue -->
<!-- Before creating an issue please make sure you are using the latest version of webpack. -->
<!-- Also consider trying the webpack@beta version, maybe it's already fixed. -->

**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**

I am reporting a bug.  (Ping @kkainu @auramo @afhole)

<!-- Please ask questions on StackOverflow or the webpack Gitter (https://gitter.im/webpack/webpack). -->
<!-- Issues which contain questions or support requests will be closed. -->

**What is the current behavior?**

When trying to import from a `pkg.module` using ES2015 module syntax (but otherwise ES5 syntax) and the module contains an `import { entry1, ... } from 'library'` declaration, WebPack crashes.

**If the current behavior is a bug, please provide the steps to reproduce.**

Clone [this repository](https://github.com/kkainu/lenses-webpack-error) and follow the instructions in the README.

<!-- A great way to do this is to provide your configuration via a GitHub gist. -->
<!-- Best provide a minimal reproduceable repo -->
<!-- If your issue is caused by a plugin or loader file the issue on the plugin/loader repo -->

**What is the expected behavior?**

The expected behavior would be for WebPack to run to completion without crashing.

If the `import { ... } from 'lib'` syntax is replaced with `import * as Lib from 'lib'` syntax, WebPack runs to completion.  Specifically, after running `npm i`, replace the first line of `node_modules/partial.lenses/dist/partial.lenses.es.js`, which is

```js
import { acyclicEqualsU, always, applyU, arityN, array0, assocPartialU, constructorOf, curry, curryN, dissocPartialU, hasU, id, identicalU, isDefined, isFunction, isObject, isString, keys, object0, pipe2U, sndU } from 'infestines';
```

with the following:

```js
import * as I from 'infestines';
var acyclicEqualsU = I.acyclicEqualsU;
var always = I.always;
var applyU = I.applyU;
var arityN = I.arityN;
var array0 = I.array0;
var assocPartialU = I.assocPartialU;
var constructorOf = I.constructorOf;
var curry = I.curry;
var curryN = I.curryN;
var dissocPartialU = I.dissocPartialU;
var hasU = I.hasU;
var id = I.id;
var identicalU = I.identicalU;
var isDefined = I.isDefined;
var isFunction = I.isFunction;
var isObject = I.isObject;
var isString = I.isString;
var keys = I.keys;
var object0 = I.object0;
var pipe2U = I.pipe2U;
var sndU = I.sndU;
```

and then run `npm run test` and WebPack will run to completion.

**Please mention other relevant information such as the browser version, Node.js version, webpack version and Operating System.**

```
$ npm ls | grep webpack
lenses@1.0.0 /Users/vesakarv/Projects/calmm-js/lenses-webpack-error
└─┬ webpack@3.5.5
  ├─┬ uglifyjs-webpack-plugin@0.4.6
  ├─┬ webpack-sources@1.0.1
$ node --version
v6.11.1
$ npm --version
3.10.10
```
